response.justification: Bogdan has extensive full-stack and AI-adjacent experience, with recent work on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks at re:cinq. While his AI-specific experience is not as deep as ideal, his leadership in engineering excellence, cloud-native development (AWS, TypeScript), and production-grade systems aligns well with the role's requirements. His lack of direct RAG or vector DB experience is a concern, but his adaptability in multi-language and multi-domain projects suggests he could ramp up quickly.
strengths: Strong full-stack engineering background with leadership experience (Staff-level at re:cinq)
Recent hands-on work with AI-agent frameworks (MCP, AI-agent infrastructure)
Proven cloud-native development (AWS CDK, TypeScript, Kubernetes) and production deployment
concerns: Limited direct experience with vector databases or RAG architectures (key for GenAI role)
No explicit mention of multi-agent system frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI) or LLM optimization
Recent AI work is primarily infrastructure-focused, with less emphasis on core GenAI system design
